from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its title and assigned case type."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    case_type: str = Field(description="The classification category for this document: '执行案件', '刑事案件', or '管辖案件'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
